decisionChannel: Founder answer in the orchestrator Claude Code session, to the question whether to accept the D1-D6 draft as-is (descriptive cohort, 0.15 margin, two blind annotators, numeric caps pending a native quota reading)

decisions.item: D1 task-family split and temporal order
decisions.detail: Lineage-based split; L4 held out only if a derived task qualifies, otherwise whole lineages; L1 never split; L3 unassigned until resolved; fixed arm-D order, Latin-square counterbalancing for A-C

decisions.item: D2 matched safety, coverage and budgets
decisions.detail: Matched model/effort/host/tools/source/route; identical hard gates; full denominators; additional cash EUR 0. Per-unit wall-time, token/quota and total unit caps deferred until an observed native quota reading
n >= 14/19/29 for delta 0.20/0.15/0.10 in the zero-failure case only; current cohort descriptive only

0.15 correctness/recovery; zero false safe admissions; 0.10 coordination precision and recall per class; useful-improvement thresholds deferred until a measured baseline; no tuning on holdout outcomes
Rubric and oracle/human/proxy labels frozen before ranking; at least two blind annotators per held-out unit when human labels are used; actual adjudication records
Stop and record on containment, route/quota, drift, exhaustion, authority, leakage or cash triggers; four predetermined report paths

limits: Freezes the evaluation protocol only. Admits no native cohort (SPEC-049/T004, SPEC-048/T008), authorizes no paid route, execution or promotion, and records no experiment outcome. Any change to a frozen value needs a new founder decision record before evaluated outcomes.
